newsitem.title: USA: General Dynamics says Chabraja to be CEO.
newsitem.headline: General Dynamics says Chabraja to be CEO.

text.p: General Dynamics Corp. Monday named Nicholas Chabraja vice chairman and said he will replace James Mellor as chairman and chief executive of the defence corporation as of June 1, 1997.
Mellor, 66, will remain on the board after he retires on May 31.

Chabraja, 54, has been executive vice president and a member of the board since May 1994. He was senior vice president and general counsel from 1993 to 1994. Chabraja had been involved in General Dynamics' legal affairs as outside counsel as a member of the Jenner & Block law firm in Chicago since 1973.
The company, based in Falls Church, Va., makes nuclear submarines, surface combatant ships and armoured vehicles. It has about 27,000 employees and annualized sales of about $4 billion.
